claimPolicy.EXT: Titles, catalogue identifiers, durations, performers, recording dates and rights are external metadata, not independent measurements. Each recording has an opened sourceUrl and was checked with audio.mjs check or archive-files. Work dates also reuse the existing composer catalogues where yearSource is a local path. Unknown dates remain unknown.
claimPolicy.MEAS: Summary counts and minutes are arithmetic over the listed, approximately second-rounded metadata durations, not audio analysis.
claimPolicy.INFERENCE: Priorities, selection rationales, completeness judgements and quality grades are editorial inferences unless explicitly supported by source descriptions. No recording was auditioned; quality grades are provisional source-based assessments, not listening reports.
claimPolicy.complete: Complete refers to the named work, including explicitly identified existing movements where applicable. False means selected complete movements or a historically arranged selection, not permission to cut a movement mid-phrase.
claimPolicy.territorial: True flags Commons PD-EU-audio recordings accepted under the lead’s Commons-licence decision, not independently established US public-domain recordings. Archive-declared PD status is separately identified.

selectionNotes: EXT: Existing bach-brandenburg-5-allegro and vivaldi-spring-allegro are referenced for set completion only, not duplicated or included in new-recording counts.
EXT: Whole-movement duration exemption is used for short character pieces, dances and vocal items. No MIDI, synthesised performance or deliberately mid-phrase audio extraction is selected.

INFERENCE: Vivaldi’s 2011 file trims need an authoring-stage endpoint check before claiming that every musical bar survives; this dossier preserves the discrepancy instead of treating the old description duration as current.

EXT: The alternative 1981-labelled Water Music F-major files were checked but not selected: their pages omit performers and the upstream WaterMusicSuiteInFmuenchinger archive item is now dark. The Marine HWV 349 set has clearer provenance.

EXT: The three performer comparisons supplied are Michel/Casals Prelude, Heifetz/Goldstein Chaconne, and Furtwängler versus Beal/Menuhin/Doráti Erbarme dich. They require separate timing maps if authored.
EXT: Rights interpretation follows the lead’s explicit Commons-hosted/PD-EU-audio decision and archive PD-or-CC-URL rule; no worldwide clearance is inferred from a European expiry tag.
MEAS: No builds, repository validators, audio analysis, or acoustic quality measurements were run. Only requested discovery/source checks and one bounded MP3 availability GET were exercised.
